# Launcher Commands

> Every `bin/bashcrawl` subcommand and what it needs, exactly as `bin/bashcrawl help` prints it.

```text
bashcrawl — learn the terminal by playing

  play             the classic dungeon: a bash subshell in entrance/ (bash only)
  tty [ARGS]       the full-screen HUD in this terminal          (Node >= 20.16)
  serve [ARGS]     telnet server on 127.0.0.1:2323 (--raw for nc) (Node)
  hub [ARGS]       telnet server in hub mode: who / say / shout / top
  web [PORT]       the browser trainer on 127.0.0.1:8000          (python3)
  courses          list the courses
  lab ID [DIR]     copy a course's lab to ~/.bashcrawl/labs/ID (--fresh moves an old one aside)
  doctor           check this machine: [ OK ] / [WARN] / [CRIT]
  reset [--dry]    restore the dungeon to a fresh game

Inside any surface: learn · lesson · skills · review · explain · help
```
